      • getIdentifier

        public Ident getIdentifier()
        Get an identifier from this pointer dereference. If the pointer variable is type "str" return the string value as an identifier. If the pointer variable is type '->' return the identifier of the variable pointed to. In either case no subscripts or fields are allowed on the dereference. If the pointer is null or the dereference has subscripts or fields, null is returned.
        Overrides:
        getIdentifier in class Node
        Returns:
        the identifier or null

      • getIdentifier

        public Ident getIdentifier(java.lang.String mess)
        Get an identifier from this pointer dereference. If the pointer variable is type "str" return the string value as an identifier. If the pointer variable is type '->' return the identifier of the variable pointed to. In either case no subscripts or fields are allowed on the dereference. If the pointer is null or the dereference has subscripts or fields, throw an exception with an error message.
        Overrides:
        getIdentifier in class Node
        Parameters:
        mess - is a string to prepend to a fatal error message
        Returns:
        the identifier

      • getIdentifier

        public Ident getIdentifier(boolean allow_subs_fields_flags,
                           java.lang.String mess)
        Check that this node has no pre/post increment/decrement operators and return the identifier. If the above checks are not met - if 'mess' is null, return null. if 'mess' is not null, throw an exception with an error message.
        Overrides:
        getIdentifier in class Node
        Parameters:
        allow_subs_fields_flags - when true, skips the subscript/field/flags check
        mess - is a string to prepend to a fatal error message
        Returns:
        the identifier

      • execute

        public Constant.EXECR execute(TDEVar esig,
                              java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> startl,
                              java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> finishl,
                              QueueRefs queues,
                              boolean toplevel,
                              boolean availok,
                              QueueRefs checkedqueues,
                              TDEVar pri_in,
                              TDEVar pri_out)
        Execute a variable appearing as a statement - 'v->++' or 'v->--'.
        Overrides:
        execute in class Node
        Parameters:
        esig - is an exception/restart signal, or null
        startl - is a list of start signals for target statements below this node
        finishl - is a list of finish signals for target statements below this node
        queues - returns all the queue availability signals accumulated from code below
        toplevel - is true if this is the top level in a module
        availok - is true if a previous sync makes a queue availability wait unnecessary
        checkedqueues - gives queue reads which have already been checked
        pri_in - is an optional input signal to a priority encoder
        pri_out - is an optional output signal from a priority encoder
        Returns:
        EXECR execution status value
